verdict.rationale: kitty documents its own programmable surfaces: kittens, an extension framework written in Python, and remote control of the terminal from scripts or the shell via an official CLI. These are first-party ways to build against kitty, but the evidence names no packaged, versioned SDK libraries for any language. missing for 10: dedicated official SDK packages (e.g., Python/JS/Go client libraries), API reference docs for an SDK, multi-language coverage, independent corroboration of SDK-based development.
